items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1966-01-20
items.q: Fowler Perez and tally holes. I caught them many witness for running around, filing behind bands on trucks that play at every corner

ctx.x: But I was one of the best flute players they had in college. And that made me believe I wanted to be a clarinet because I could play so much of the flute. And at that time we had the band Wagons. This furniture wagon used to move with the furniture around the city, the trucks used to move them on the wagon. And on Sunday they put a band on the wagon for different clubs and the clubs would ride in tally holes. I don't know if you ever saw a tally hole. Now what is it? A tally hole is made, it's long, long this way…
Well the club would be advertising their dance on the tally hole? Yeah.
